evidence_items.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
evidence_items.locator: Estimated AI Adoption Rates, paragraph discussing the November 2025 Real-Time Population Survey

receipt.public_excerpt: The most recent quarter saw the strongest growth in work-related adoption over the course of the RPS series.

evidence_items.explanation: The analysis reports rising work-related and non-work generative-AI adoption through November 2025. It does not establish the triggering decline, but adoption shares cannot exclude falling usage intensity or a later contraction.

evidence_items.locator: Regular AI usage, paragraph discussing respondents who do not use chatbots

receipt.public_excerpt: That suggests more and more people are taking against the very idea of AI

evidence_items.explanation: The report describes a 1,008-person survey in which several-times-daily chatbot use fell relative to the previous year and non-use increased. This supports a narrower consumer decline, but does not establish a broad contraction including enterprise and API usage; survey field dates and sufficient sampling details are absent.

receipt.public_excerpt: Vacancy held steady at 1.4% compared with year-end 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: CBRE reports low vacancy in eight primary North American data-center markets for the first half of 2026. This measures market vacancy rather than global AI computing utilization and is not evidence about capacity following an established usage contraction.
